summary: Frontend-only testing of custom 'label' (sub-category) inputs for Unity Network, Nosana, and GoMining integrations. All 4 requested flows pass: smoke load of /integrations with all 5 cards rendering, Unity Network update dialog label input visible/filled/confirmed, Nosana config dialog label input visible and label persisted to localStorage key networth_nosana_config, GoMining update dialog label input visible when GMT delta>0 + earning action.

issues: CoinGecko returns 429 (rate-limited) and the CORS proxy fallback also fails in preview env (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED). Manual price override works as built-in mitigation, so this is expected per problem statement. No action needed.

critical_code_review_comments: All three components correctly add a controlled `label` state, reset it on dialog open, and only expose the input when action is earning/boost — good UX.
Unity Network + GoMining pass `label.trim() || null` to their apply* functions; Nosana stores `label` inside config so auto-sync can tag transactions — implementation matches requirements.
GoMiningEarningsCard.jsx is ~800 lines (approaching split threshold). Consider extracting BalanceSide + GoMiningUpdateDialog into their own files if more features are added.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage entries for networth_unity_network_config and networth_gomining_token_config (baseline=0, enabled=true) via page.evaluate to test update flows. Nosana config saved via UI through NosanaConfigDialog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI verification complete. data-testids are present and correct: unity-network-label-input, nosana-label-input, gomining-label-input. CoinGecko is 429-rate-limited in the preview env — use gomining-manual-gmt-price / gomining-manual-btc-price to override. To test GoMining earning action you must seed baseline=0 and enter a higher balance. Unity Network label only appears when delta>0 and action=earning.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature addition test; all acceptance criteria pass.
